encounter_assumptions.rule: The Eye grants 1% spell critical chance and has a 20-second spell hit on-use. The Reed grants 15 spell power here. Missing non-DPS effects (enemy tracking, ally disarm) do not affect this encounter. Cooldowns for drinking 4696 or banking unabsorbed fire damage with 20036 are inactive.

references_note: With pre-raid ranged-slot relics 272430 (Balance), 23199 (Elemental), 23203 (Shockadin); Balance uses Headmaster’s Charge with Spellblasting. Each reference is faction-specific. Gains refer only to its exact rotation and gear.
scope: Pre-raid PvE, neutral level-63 boss, no struck-by-fire or marsh bonus. Both trinkets empty for the first gain; for a partner, its exact item stays equipped. Other slots, race, rotation and other cooldowns stay fixed. On-use actions ordered by ascending item ID.
